svg.title: Растяжка трицепса над головой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Overhead triceps stretch. One upright adult, one upper arm beside head pointing straight up, elbow bent so forearm and hand reach down behind head toward upper back. Opposite hand lightly supports the raised elbow. Both hands visible, no weight. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
